top.en: If you're a veteran LPL viewer, you should feel moved. It's been too long since we've had an ADC who dominates the big stage like this. I'll say it again: he feels just like Gumayusi during his first Worlds in 2022. Same thing in the US, winning lane every single game. JiaQi even idolizes Gumayusi. He plays so aggressively; he doesn't look like a rookie at his first Worlds at all. He has nerves of steel. His mechanics, his weirdly high CS numbers, and his lane pressure—he just manhandles Ruler, Gumayusi, and Berserker. Even in the game he lost to Ruler, he was winning the lane early-mid. Sure, his support helped, but his own skill and composure are key. If you give him an aggressive lane combo, he just crushes the opponent. Unlike Uzi, he doesn't even need the jungler's help. If you watched how the LPL bot lanes were getting abused by T1 for those four years, you'll get the same feeling watching JiaQi play against these three Korean ADCs. If you actually watch the games, you'll see his playstyle is identical to 2022 Worlds Gumayusi. Both are first-timers at Worlds, and compared to Hope, it's like night and day.

bp声响起的41秒内，场馆上方再次响起了TheShy的吟唱。【武圣】【姜王】【仙人指路】【天神下凡】、Dhokla明白，自己再也没有机会阻止【天上魔主】的降生了，无顾虑的ts如同神王般在比赛内游龙，inspired的进攻在【天上魔主】的操作下化为乌有，坐椅之上，全力保持专注的Dhokla无力的瘫坐在屏幕前保持镇定，他的希望和意志被【天上魔主】吞噬殆尽，同样燃尽的杰斯出现在奎桑提面前，Dhokla立刻操作奎桑提顶在队伍面前强行保住队形完整，但是在TheShy的操作下，杰斯的威胁大大增强，在Meiko的帮助下，ts的血量再次恢复，对ts来说，即兴的【天上魔主】只是神力的一半回归，结果inspired失去节奏，“看来神力并未全失”，谁能想到inspired和Dhokla发了疯针对的只是恢复一半神力的ts，ts在比赛的20分钟内见招拆招，完成了数个可以载入集锦的操作。粉丝呆呆的看着屏幕任不可置信，“也就是说……”，“没错，是IG赢了！”
八强的门票，铭刻于德克萨斯州
top.en: Within 41 seconds of the draft music starting, TheShy's chant echoed through the venue again. [Martial Saint], [King Jiang], [Immortal Pointing the Way], [Descent of the Heavenly God]. Dhokla knows he has no chance to stop the birth of the [Heavenly Demon Lord]. The unburdened TheShy roams the rift like a god-king. Inspired's offense dissolves under the [Heavenly Demon Lord]'s mechanics. Sitting in his chair, Dhokla tries to stay focused but collapses helplessly in front of his screen. His hope and will are devoured by the [Heavenly Demon Lord]. A burnt-out Jayce appears before K'Sante. Dhokla immediately uses K'Sante to stand in front of his team to force a formation, but under TheShy's control, Jayce's threat is greatly amplified. With Meiko's help, TheShy's health recovers. For TheShy, the impromptu [Heavenly Demon Lord] is only half his divine power returning. As a result, Inspired loses his rhythm. 'It seems the divine power isn't fully gone.' Who could have thought that the target Inspired and Dhokla went crazy trying to shut down was only using half his power? TheShy countered every move in those 20 minutes, pulling off several highlight-reel plays. Fans stared at the screen in disbelief. 'You mean...', 'That's right, IG won!' The ticket to the quarterfinals is engraved in Texas.

他选的时候，其实纠结了很久，对面没选岩雀我们也没选，安妮之前就说了，会不会去抢岩雀更好
他当时其实应该是在纠结如果抢了岩雀，会不会有别的解法？所以没有百分百确定。
但最终的结论应该还是得抢。但是当他得出这个结论的时候，已经抢了安妮，他也就没话说了。
不过最后进入了游戏，他最后又一寻思，还是发现不对，就是得抢岩雀，所以他在进入游戏还没对线前就说了。
thread.en: When he was picking, he was actually conflicted for a long time. The opponent didn't pick Taliyah, and we didn't either. He mentioned Annie earlier, but wondered if picking Taliyah would be better. He was probably debating if there were other solutions if they took Taliyah, so he wasn't 100% sure. But the final conclusion should have been to take her. By the time he reached that conclusion, they had already picked Annie, so he had nothing left to say. But once they got into the game, he thought about it again and realized he was right, they should have taken Taliyah, so he said it before the laning phase even started.
